meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会进入‘超计划模式’：它召集 5 个互相唱反调的成员，让它们激烈互相挑错，只提炼出经得起攻击的想法，再强制交给专门的规划助手写成可执行的工作计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”“hpp”“/hyperplan”等触发词，或提出对抗性/交叉批判式的规划要求时触发。也适用于需要暴露薄弱假设、盲点和过度工程的高严谨规划场景。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我规划新功能的上线步骤。
say.note: Claude 会宣告‘超计划模式已启用’并开始对抗性评审。

say.text: hpp：对这份方案做对抗性交叉批判。
say.note: 五个对抗成员会轮流攻击方案。

say.text: 请做交叉批判式规划，找出方案里的薄弱假设。
say.note: Claude 会召集对抗团队逐一批评。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude enters 'HYPERPLAN MODE': it assembles 5 mutually hostile members who fiercely critique each other, distills only the ideas that survive, then hands the distilled insights to the `plan` agent to formalize an executable work plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say keywords like 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', or request adversarial/cross-critique planning. Also fits planning that needs maximum rigor and surfacing weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan the rollout of the new feature.
say_en.note: Claude announces mode and starts adversarial review.

say_en.text: hpp: run adversarial cross-critique on this plan.
say_en.note: Five hostile members attack the plan in turn.

say_en.text: Do cross-critique planning to surface weak assumptions.
say_en.note: Claude will assemble the adversarial team to critique.
